This minimal fixture is derived from the metadata and citations in
`~/notebook/papers/eigenmode/content.md`. The original project is read only.
The bibliography contains a placeholder existing entry so its preservation can
be checked without copying the project's bibliography.

`exports.json` records the local Better BibTeX responses observed during the
smoke test, with nonessential fields omitted from the successful exports.
Guinness was missing from the default personal library. Ordinary tests use these
responses and never connect to Zotero.
